description: NaCoO₂ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the trigonal P̅3m1 space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent CoO₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and faces with two equivalent CoO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 48°. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.41 Å. Co is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form CoO₆ octahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent CoO₆ octahedra, and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 48°. All Co-O bond lengths are 2.05 Å. O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Co atoms.
